title: No landing gate runs pool check, so a landing that closes a _gaps.md entry a gap row names, or leaves an sc_stale row unstale, lands green
goal: kbgit.py sync runs benchmarks.py pool check when bench_pool.csv, bench_scenarios.csv or a root's _gaps.md changes and refuses only the problems the landing adds, so the landing that closes an entry a gap row still names fails while the pool's old defects do not

run: import sys;s=open('_tools/kg_sync.py',encoding='utf-8').read();ok='"pool", "check"' in s;print(ok);sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)

repro_reason: the gate list is a table of kg_sync.py; a landing fixture that closes a gap entry is the planner's to add

run: import sys; sys.path.insert(0, "_tools"); import kg_sync as k; paths = ("kb/public/_gaps.md", "kb/public/_retrieval/bench_pool.csv", "kb/public/_retrieval/bench_scenarios.csv"); missing = [p for p in paths if not k.gate_needs({p}).get("pool")]; extra = k.gate_needs({"_tools/kg_sync.py"}).get("pool"); print("pool gate missing for:", missing, "| runs for an unrelated path:", bool(extra)); sys.exit(1 if missing or extra else 0)

gates.question: What does the sync gate's pool check refuse, given that pool check already fails on the base for rows no landing of this sprint can fix (a redraw asks the model, a paid run)? Recommended: refuse only the problems the landing adds (a pool row it adds or changes with a defect, a gap row whose _gaps.md entry it closes) and print the old defects without refusing.
options: Refuse only what the landing adds
Refuse every problem pool check prints
No pool gate until the pool is redrawn
gates.recommendation: Refuse only what the landing adds
gates.answer: Refuse only what the landing adds
